text_block_list.text:
We're almost halfway through summer
camp, yet
it doesn't seem like Silence
Suzuka's managed to
regain her usual
vigor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for the summer camp
scrimmage,
and everyone has high
expectations for Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(I wonder what her... dream is? What is
it... that
makes her run?)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: (No! I have to focus!)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
In the end, she fails to meet those
expectations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I wonder what's going on with Silence
Suzuka.
Ever since we got to summer
camp, she hasn't
seemed well.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Really? I hadn't noticed at all... Do you
think she's
already peaked?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
Later that night, I find Сайленс Судзука
standing
alone outside the camp
lodgings.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can do to help?

text_block_list.text:
She gazes at her feet for a moment
before finally
opening her mouth to
respond. Her voice is
wavering and
hesitant.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Up until recently... the only thing on my
mind
when I ran was getting into the
lead.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
But now... I find myself wondering about
the other
racers.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
What are their dreams? What is it that
motivates
them to run?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: All I can think about is...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
The things that I've done to them to get
here!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I don't know what to do...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: Just focus on running how you always do.

text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list:
You aren't crushing other people's dreams by
running.

text_block_list.text:
The expectations of the crowd, their
cheers and
applause... They aren't just
encouragement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: That can't be true...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: At the very least, you inspire me.

text_block_list.text: Thank you. Still...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
The runners who lost could not stop
crying.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, I have to go.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: She returns to the lodge, still dejected.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The next day...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: (My body feels like... it's made of lead.)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
All of a sudden, the clamor of a
racecourse can
be heard from the
common room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"Look at her go! Сайленс Судзука simply
refuses to
slow down! What speed!"
text_block_list.name: Racing Commentator

text_block_list.text: (Is that one of my races?)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
We peek into the common room to find
Special
Week with her eyes glued to the
TV watching
race footage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: So coool!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Man... I've still got a lot of work to do.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Ah! S-Suzuka! Good morning!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it kind of feels like you just
jumped out of
the TV and into real life!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: What were you watching?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... To tell you the truth, I've kind
of been
in a slump lately.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
So I thought I'd watch you run to get
some
motivation.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I mean, check it out! The race is only
half over,
but look at your lead! And it's
growing!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик points at the television
screen.
Displayed is a determined
Сайленс Судзука leaving
the other runners
in the dust.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Why?! After everything... After all the
work I've
done!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука shuts off the TV without
a word.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Suzuka?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm sorry. I should've asked you
before I put
it on.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: No, it's okay.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It's just... Watching me isn't going to
motivate
you.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you talking about?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I-it totally works! Like, I love this part
here!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик turns the TV back on
frantically
and rewinds the recording.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"Look at her go! Сайленс Судзука simply
refuses to
slow down! What speed!"
text_block_list.name: Racing Commentator

text_block_list.text:
"She's unstoppable! No one can catch up
to her!"
text_block_list.name: Racing Commentator

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I bet I know just how the other
racers are
feeling around this point.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
They're thinking that no matter how fast
they run,
they just can't keep up.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
They're thinking about how they've
failed again.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: (So that really is what they think...)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
But! That's exactly the motivation that
starts a
fire in you!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It's like: "One day, I'll catch up! No
matter what!"
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
When I watch you run, it makes me want
to do
better!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
"You aren't crushing other people's
dreams by
running."
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: "You're inspiring people."
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: (Am I really?)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Thank you...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: For what?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Thank you for your admiration.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wh-wh-what's with that all of a
sudden?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: It's... it's okay if I run, right?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
What? Of course it is! Why? Did
something bad
happen?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Hehe. No. Nothing at all.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry about yesterday.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: And I wanted to thank you.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
This morning, I was finally able to
understand
what you told me before.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I don't need to change anything about
how I run.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука puts her worries behind
her and
looks ahead with rekindled
determination. It's like
time has been
turned back to before summer
camp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What should we do today? Maybe some
mountain
running?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: Let's do some strength training on the beach!
Let's do a lap around the mountain!

text_block_list.text: Beach strength training, huh? ...Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I love looking out at the ocean when I
train. This
will be fun.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: A lap around the mountain?!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Actually, I feel like I can do it.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I've seen her smile
like this.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
For the first time in months, I see Silence
Suzuka
running like her normal self, free
and
unrestrained.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
